identified_without_signature.what: VAB body: concatenated raw PSX 4-bit ADPCM samples (content type 7)
identified_without_signature.basis: Within one EMI archive, a mode-7 body pairs only with the latest preceding mode-6 VAB version-7 header. The header size must match a program count no greater than 128; sample count at +0x16 must be at most 255. Size-table slots zero through that count, inclusive, sum to the nonempty body length in eight-byte units.

Original-US mode-3 raw VRAM tile words

check.detail: Exact original-US EMI size/SHA256 membership; TOC mode 3; payload check word equals TOC +8; positive whole 0x800-byte sectors; complete tile rows within 1024x512-word VRAM. Packed TOC +4 gives column=(arg>>24)&0x3f, row=(arg>>16)&0x1f, width=(arg>>8)&0x3f. Width must be positive; sector count divisible by width; column+width <=32 and row+sector_count/width <=16.

not_machine_identifiable.why: These payloads have no self-identifying signature. Only exact original-US archives meeting the mode-3 tile rule are classified from loader evidence.
